sources.title: AI Model Development: A Complete Step-by-Step Guide
sources.snippet: Learn the end-to-end AI model development process — from problem framing and data collection through training, evaluation, deployment, and drift monitoring.

sources.title: ddjapri/act_physical_ai_hack_policy_v1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Card for act Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) is an imitation-learning method that predicts short action chunks instead of single steps. It learns from teleoperated data and often achieves high success rates. This policy has been trained and pushed to the Hub using LeRobot. See the full documentation at LeRobot Docs.

sources.title: Create Policy Models in AI Agent Studio Interface
sources.snippet: Policy models enable AI agents to consistently enforce business policies and operational rules through fast, deterministic runtime evaluation. This model reduces operational risk, improves compliance, simplifies policy maintenance, and accelerates decision-making across workflows such as approvals, eligibility validation, and compliance checks.
